method: Pinned source audit plus documented native configuration semantics; no CCEC/device validation.
scope: Default A2/A3 two-operand FP32 Acc to FP32 packed ND GM; no pre-quantization, pre-ReLU, nondefault phase/cache.
findings: Default TSTORE_IMPL enables atomic mode, invokes the same TStoreAcc geometry, resets atomic mode; selected path contains no scratch or numbered events.
Read and write refer to the same GM rectangle. Existing GM contents are required, not implicitly initialized.
Configuration-to-subsequent-transfer order is a documented native property; earlier payload completion, cross-worker visibility and deterministic reduction are separate obligations.
